text:
maya: quick q — we need to align on TTFT and tokens/sec p95 for the new runtime dashboard. are we measuring TTFT from router receive or from model container accept?
alex: from router receive. we've been using the router->first-token edge for SLOs so dashboards should match that.
ryan: fwiw the dashboard currently pulls TTFT as `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(router_to_first_token_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))` — that comes from the router prometheus metric.
sam: cool. for tok/s p95 do we want per-request tokens/sec (tokens / request_duration) p95, or aggregate throughput per GPU p95?
maya: I'd prefer both panels: request-level p95 to catch long-tail bad requests, and cluster-level tok/s to watch capacity. teams care about different things.
ryan: agreed. request-level query we use is `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_tokens_per_second_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, config))`. cluster-level is `sum(rate(tokens_emitted_total[1m])) by (instance)` with a moving 5m avg.
alex: note: request-level metric relies on accurate `request_tokens` instrumentation. @sam can you confirm the PR that added that?
sam: yep PR #4127 — added `request_tokens` and `request_duration` labels. instrumented in runtime v2.3.1.
maya: perfect. next: alert thresholds. proposing TTFT p95 > 250ms triggers a warning, > 400ms is critical. tok/s drop > 30% vs rolling baseline -> paging. thoughts?
ryan: +1 for those thresholds. suggest making thresholds per-model (smaller models stricter) and per-tier (dedicated vs hosted).
alex: agreed. Will add model and customer_tier labels to alert rules.
perf-bot: benchmark run finished: regression check on v2.3.1 vs v2.3.0 — no p95 TTFT regression on small models, ~5% tok/s improvement on Llama-13B quantized. details: https://perf.redwood/internal/174200/summary
maya: thanks. @ryan @alex can we sync next week to update the panel layout? I can draft layout in `dashboards/runtime/ttft_tok_s.json` and open a PR.
ci-bot: CI passed for dashboard PR draft branch `dashboard/ttft-update`.
alex: thanks all — I'll follow up with a short doc on metric defs and a PR to unify the queries. :white_check_mark:
